description: Open Scriptura's reader inside the chat: the original beside the translation (or two Bible editions side by side), paragraph by paragraph, each with its permanent scriptura.si link. With nothing given it opens a short list of ways in. Give a work (slug or id, from search_shelf) with an optional section and paragraph (both 1-based, default section 1), or a Bible reference in any common form ("Jn 1:1", "Genesis 14:18-20", "JHN.3") with up to two editions ("kjv", "greek-nt", "hebrew", ids from list_editions). A scriptura.si address also works. The result lists the first page of paragraph pairs, each with url and cite; in hosts that render the reader, the person can turn pages and the paragraph they open is shared with you so you can quote it exactly. Cite every paragraph you use with its link.

editions.description: Bible only: one or two edition ids, e.g. ["kjv","greek-nt"]; the first is the left column.

paragraph.description: Paragraph (1-based, as read_work counts) or verse to open at. Default: the first.

section.description: Section of the work, or chapter of the Bible book. Default 1.

work.description: A work slug or shelf id, e.g. "plato-republic".

name: open_reader

cite.description: Ready citation naming Scriptura, ending with the link.

paragraph.description: Paragraph number (1-based, as read_work counts) or verse number.

texts.description: One text per column: [original, translation], or two Bible editions.

url.description: Permanent scriptura.si link to this paragraph or verse.

starts.description: Opened with nothing to open: ways in, each with the open_reader arguments that open it.

title: Open the reader
